name: terrain-integrity-v2
description: v2: localized, visually observable signs only. Steps, sharp block edges, exposed side faces and height changes are normal. The finite world edge (dark background beyond the last blocks) is normal too: a gap counts only when ground surrounds it.

gap_in_ground.instructions: Is there an area in `screenshot` where plain dark background shows through, with ground visible around it on at least two sides?

gap_box.instructions: Where is the area in `screenshot` where plain dark background shows through, with ground visible around it?

off_palette_patch.instructions: Is there a block-shaped patch on the ground in `screenshot` whose colour is clearly neither green, brown nor grey?
